consequence.statement: The addition only introduces a read-only status field in the ScrapeConfig v1alpha1 schema that is populated solely when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled; no existing resource, configuration or workload is affected by the schema addition itself.
consequence.remediation: No action required; environments wanting populated status output may enable the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate.

assertion.statement: A new top-level status field (with status.bindings[] and its conditions, group, name, namespace and resource sub-fields) was added to the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 ScrapeConfig schema, computed between prometheus-operator 0.85.0 and 0.86.2; the evidence describes it as a read-only status subresource that is only updated when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled.
